name: shiye
description: 办事师爷 · 随手记一句话，AI 拆成任务，到点提醒 · 365 开源计划 #035
author: rockbenben

scripts.go: npm install && npm run build && npm start
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p web/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p server/tsconfig.typecheck.json && tsc -p desktop/tsconfig.typecheck.json
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w desktop && electron desktop/dist/main.js
scripts.dist:desktop: npm run build && npm run build -w desktop && electron-builder --config desktop/electron-builder.yml
